Let's make your city self
Somnucor is the city every dreamer shares: streets full of people, work and wages, a bank, a home, and a door of your own in the Hall of Doors .
A few quick choices and you're ready. You can change any of them later.
You can walk the city as a visitor. A job, a home and gold come with membership.
Yes, set me up in the city
Leave the city, just my own dreams
No thanks, just my own dreams
Saying no keeps the dream journal and your own dreamscape exactly as they are. Nothing of the city is built, and you can join any time in Settings.
What should people call you?
This is the name over your head in Somnucor, and the one the city's people use when they talk to you.
No surnames or addresses needed. Something friendly is perfect.
A name, please — any name you like.
Pick your clothes, hair and colours in the wardrobe. It opens on you, in a mirror.
👗 Open the wardrobe
You can skip this. The wardrobe is always under B on a keyboard, or 🎒 Backpack › Wardrobe .
Your door in the Hall of Doors
Every dreamer has a door in the great hall. Its name is lettered on the nameplate, and walking through it takes you home.
🎨 Dress up my door
Once it stands you can dress it up (shape, colour, light, ornaments): ☰ Menu › 🚪 My door .
Give your door a name — yours is fine.
What work would you love?
Pick what sounds most like you. We'll show you posts that match, and the city's bosses can see what dreamers would like to do.
Jobs come with membership. Pick one anyway, and it's ready for you when you join.
🏙️ Take me to Somnucor
